messages:
Nate (releases): FYI planning a maintenance/change window tonight 22:00 UTC for runtime v2.7.1 rollout. No schema changes but kernel and batching tweaks. Expect ~20m for canary then staggered.
DeployBot: Scheduled: deploy:v2.7.1 to runtime-prod at 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z. Canary: 5% for 20m -> then 25% -> 100%. Rollback window: 60m after canary.
Amy (infra): Noted. I'll pin dedicated customers to v2.6.9 by default during the window unless they opt in. Which customers need manual comms?
Maria (support): I've got a list of three large Dedicated tenants and two Private customers that require pre-notify. Will draft a short statuspage + email snippet.
Sam (oncall): Add health checks in the canary path: memory/jitter spike alert and 95th p99 latency > 400ms. If any fire, canary hold and rollback.
Nate (releases): Agreed. Rollback policy: immediate rollback to v2.6.9 if errors >0.5% or latency regressions >30% on canary. Amy please confirm pinning automation will hold during rollback.
Amy (infra): Confirmed. Pin jobs will only flip if rollout reaches 100%. If rollback occurs, pins remain at v2.6.9.
Maria (support): Draft statuspage blurb (short):
```
Maintenance: runtime improvements deploy (v2.7.1) — planned 22:00 UTC. Expected brief canary and staggered rollout; some customers on Dedicated will remain pinned to v2.6.9. No functional API changes expected. We will update the status page if there are any service impacts.
```
Maria (support): Draft email snippet for affected customers: "We plan a maintenance window at 22:00 UTC to deploy runtime optimizations. Your Dedicated instance will remain pinned to the prior version unless you opt-in. If you'd like to test v2.7.1 in a staging bucket before GA, reply and we can enable it." Thoughts?
Nate (releases): Good. Add a line about rollback policy and a contact alias: support@redwood.ai or #support in Slack. Keep it short.
Sam (oncall): I'll own oncall during the window. Will post a canary summary at +20m and final at completion. If I hit issues, I'll post: "canary-hold: reason => rollback" and trigger rollback.
DeployBot: Canary started at 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z for 5% traffic. Canary ID: cb-1965432100.
Sam (oncall): Canary metrics: p95 +10% (ok), error rate 0.02% (ok). Holding for full 20m.
StatusBot: Status page update queued: "Maintenance scheduled: runtime v2.7.1 deploy starting 22:00 UTC. Canaries in progress; we'll post updates."
Maria (support): Copy of final statuspage text for ops review: "We are deploying performance improvements to the inference runtime. A brief canary is in progress. Some Dedicated customers will remain on the prior version to avoid risk; no API changes expected. We'll update if there is any impact."
Nate (releases): After canary, we will move to 25% -> 60% -> 100% over 40m with health checks gating each step. Reminder: small customers on hosted may see token-level latency improvements.
Amy (infra): Noted. Autoscaler warm-up configured for the rollout cadence.
Sam (oncall): +8m canary: metrics steady. Proceeding to 25% now.
DeployBot: Rollout progressed to 25% at 2026-03-20T22:28:00Z.
Maria (support): Sending pre-notify email now to affected customers (using support alias). Template link: https://inbox.redwood.ai/templates/maint-v2-7-1
Nate (releases): Great. If any customer calls, route to Maria/Sam. I'll draft a short release-note snippet for the docs site: bullet list of kernel improvements, batching tweaks, and a note about no API changes.
Sam (oncall): 25% -> 60% looks clean. No errors. Proceed to 100%.
DeployBot: Rollout complete at 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z to 100%. Canary ID cb-1965432100 closed.
Sam (oncall): Final check: p99 latency -2% vs baseline, errors unchanged. Marking as successful.
Nate (releases): Closing window. Maria can send final statuspage update: "Maintenance complete: runtime v2.7.1 deployed; no customer-facing impact observed; Dedicated customers remain on pinned version unless they opt-in."
StatusBot: Status page updated: maintenance complete.
Maria (support): Final email sent to affected customers with rollback contact and opt-in instructions. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Nate (releases): Nice work. Quick retrospective note: next time include a one-line regression test for topo configs to speed canary confidence.
Amy (infra): Will add that to the release checklist.
Sam (oncall): Logged postmortem stub in #postmortems with metrics attached.
